title: Joseph W. "Joe" Gauld
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Joseph Gauld (1927-2023), founder of Hyde School. His own 1974 interview and newspaper columns describe the school's physical discipline; the 2025 federal suit's claims are allegations.

meta.person_role: Founder, headmaster and later president of Hyde School, Bath, Maine

person_notable_work: Founded Hyde School in 1966 and led it until his death
Described slapping, paddling and self-criticism sessions in a 1974 interview
Wrote Character First: The Hyde School Difference (1993)
